from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def basis(p):
    return [eps*np.log(eps)*T**2, np.tanh(p[0]*eps)*T**2, eps*np.log(eps)*T, np.tanh(p[1]*eps)/T**2, eps*np.tanh(p[2]*eps)/T, np.tanh(p[3]*eps)]
def model(p):
    B=np.array(basis(p)).T
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
    return B,c
def res(p):
    B,c=model(p); return sigma-B@c
best=None
for p0 in [[1,1,1,1],[0.5,2,1,3],[2,0.5,2,0.5],[1,3,0.3,1]]:
    r=least_squares(res,p0)
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
B,c=model(best.x)
print("p",best.x,"coef",c,"nmse",np.mean((sigma-B@c)**2)/np.var(sigma))
